enchantment.inscribe.double_jump.desc: Press jump in mid-air to double jump. Level I: up to 2.5 blocks total; Level II: up to 3.5 blocks total.
enchantment.inscribe.thunderstrike.desc: On hit, call lightning down on the target. The lightning does not harm the attacker. Only living entities are struck.
enchantment.inscribe.swift_strike.desc: Attack cooldown and bow/crossbow draw speed are 10%/20%/30% faster per level.
enchantment.inscribe.sunder.desc: Critical axe hits apply a 10s armor break to armored targets. Your damage ignores part of their armor and toughness; potions are unaffected.
enchantment.inscribe.life_siphon.desc: Steal 20% of damage dealt as health (rounded down, max 4). Killing a non-skeleton target heals 2.
enchantment.inscribe.lava_walker.desc: Turn nearby lava into a temporary lava shell. Higher levels widen the area. Conflicts with Frost Walker.
enchantment.inscribe.immolation.desc: Monster kills convert dropped items into XP: 2/4/6 per item. Looting applies first. Bosses and player drops are preserved.
enchantment.inscribe.unscathed.desc: After 10s without any damage, gain a shield. The next damage from an attacker is reduced to 1. Any damage consumes the shield and resets the timer.
enchantment.inscribe.frost_thorns.desc: When attacked, chance to apply Frost Thorns to the attacker: slow plus mining fatigue.
effect.inscribe.frost_thorns.desc: Reduces movement speed, attack speed and mining speed.
enchantment.inscribe.beheading.desc: Axes drop the matching vanilla head when killing a zombie, skeleton, wither skeleton, creeper, ender dragon or player.
enchantment.inscribe.hunt.desc: Consecutive hits on the same target build Hunt stacks, increasing melee damage; switching targets or 4 seconds without a hit resets it.
effect.inscribe.hunt.desc: Each stack increases melee damage; switching targets or 4 seconds without a hit resets it.
